description: Cast a hexagram for an I-Ching consultation. Returns the primary hexagram, the six lines (6=old yin, 7=young yang, 8=young yin, 9=old yang from bottom to top), any moving lines, and the changing hexagram if there are moving lines. Pass `seed` to make the cast deterministic (useful for testing or for reproducing a reading).

method.description: coins = three-coin toss (most common); yarrow = traditional 50-stalk probabilities; random = uniformly pick one of the 64 hexagrams with no moving lines.

question.description: The question being asked (not used for casting, returned in result for context).

name: cast_hexagram
